coordinate_system: pixels in each PNG, origin top-left; anchor = point that attaches to the body. Fish faces right.

fin-tail-delta.note: right edge = where the tail joins the caudal peduncle

fin-tail-halfmoon.note: right edge = where the tail joins the caudal peduncle

fin-tail-swallow.note: right edge = where the tail joins the caudal peduncle

fin-pectoral-dumbo.note: right edge = attaches behind the gills; fan spreads back (left). Scale ~0.5x of body length

fin-sword-top.note: right end = base at the upper edge of the tail; blade points back-up

fin-sword-bottom.note: vertical mirror of fin-sword-top; base at the lower edge of the tail

fin-tail-doublesword.note: composed from fin-sword-top + mirror; right middle = caudal peduncle
